core.title: Stainless Steel Mortise Lock Entry Leverset, AHI SIG123AM48-243

text.description_html:
AHI Stainless Steel Mortise Lock Entry Leverset

All Stainless Steel Trim: Extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not degrade in appearance or function with use.

Mortise Lockcase: Heavy gauge plated steel UL & ULC listed for custom residential, high traffic commercial, institutional and industrial uses where durability and security are of the greatest concern. Lock function for use with Schlage C Series cylinders. UL-listed for 3 hours. UL label stamped on front (ULC available) UL sticker on case.

Specifications:

  • Function: Standard Entry
  • Mortise Case Faceplate: 1-1/4" Stainless steel
  • Latch Bolt: Brass anti-friction type
  • Deadbolt: Forged brass with hardened steel inserts
  • Backset: 2 3/4" (70mm)
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" Minimum thickness, optional up to 3-1/2" thick
  • Strike plate: Stainless steel ANSI standard 4-7/8" x 1-1/4" x 1-1/8" lip to center
  • Trim Plate Height: 9.68" (246 mm)
  • Trim Plate Width: 1.89" (48 mm)
  • Trim Plate Thickness: 0.275" (7 mm)
  • Solid Stainless Steel Trim
  • Door Levers: AHI SIG123 Levers

Also available: Matching Stainless Steel Dummy Leverset for the inactive door on a French Door Set (Double Doors).

Available in Satin or Polished Stainless finishes.
